keep: Canonical PublicMarketingChrome header/footer, existing marketing pages and workspace routes, /dashboard/integrations/[plugin] detail route.

INTEGRATIONS static technology catalog, PLUGIN_DEFINITIONS as qualified app guide descriptions, CONNECTABLE_INTEGRATION_IDS for intentionally constrained provider setup; do not modify runtime controls.
extend: Dark-blue responsive public marketing interface with hero, featured app logos, three-step explanation, remote MCP callout and 711-entry directory with searchable filters and paging.
Source-grounded native/app-guide/technology categorization with exact source industry filters and curated topic filters.
Public cards link to the authorized dashboard, where live action/trigger details and account connection state can actually be checked.
replace: Former local header, static 24 small text cards, and minimal /integrations SEO presentation.

schemaImpact.rollout: UI-only. Draft PR and preview; no database changes.
schemaImpact.rollback: Revert this route and its new companion UI/data/test/stylesheet files.

auth.description: No connection/auth flows changed. Public links navigate to existing protected workspace detail routes.

tenant.description: No workspace tenant or user-specific connection state is queried from the public page.

approval.description: No new external tool actions or approvals; only discoverability and navigation.

credentials.description: No tokens are accepted, stored, revealed or sent by the public page.

egress.description: Public app logos reuse PluginBrandLogo's existing approved mapping and Simple Icons fallback, now rendered for displayed cards; no new endpoints or auth-carrying requests.

cost.description: No inference charges, provider calls, or new dependencies.

billing.description: Links to existing free signup; no billing changes.

tests.scope: Lint the new public route and catalog client under Next 15.
Compile Next 15, route and public client, metadata and CSS.
Canonical 711-entry list, category fidelity, Shopify route, no static user connection claims.

tests.command: Manual responsive, keyboard and action smoke test
tests.scope: Actual desktop/mobile preview at 390/768/1440 px: single global header, input typing and reduced-motion, search, filter, load more, card navigation to login-protected detail, custom MCP link.

architecture.reason: Existing public marketing layer and authenticated Xroga Connect plugin marketplace are preserved, without a second integration runtime or credential path.

rollout: Preview environment only after checks. Never merge, promote, or reassign xroga.com domain without a separate explicit production approval.
rollback: Discard the branch or revert its /integrations UI/data/stylesheet/test/manifest files; production main unaffected.
knownGaps: 711 is the static build technology catalog count as of this branch; it is NOT 711 authorized, live provider connectors, 2,000+ live connectors, 3,000+, or unlimited integrations.
Auth scheme and real tools/triggers are discovered on authenticated detail; public cards never claim an exact count or an already-connected account.
Custom MCP links to existing /dashboard/integrations?view=custom and depends on runtime configuration, security checks and supported server compatibility.
Brand images use existing external Simple Icons mappings and fall back to letters where unsupported.
No real browser screenshot or deployment is claimed until a verified exact-commit preview exists.
Repository-wide CI contains historical mission-policy and inventory checks unrelated to this scoped UI; must not bypass.
Full interactive search/keyboard/breakpoint checks require actual browser preview.

blockers: Pass exact-head frontend build, catalog tests, responsive/accessibility review and obtain actual preview before merging.
Separate owner production approval required; Vercel free quota may prevent preview creation.
